permissionsOf.details: An account can give an operator permissions that only pertain to a specific project ID.There is no project with a ID of 0 – this ID is a wildcard which gives an operator permissions pertaining to *all* project IDs on an account's behalf. Use this with caution.Permissions are stored in a packed `uint256`. Each of the 256 bits represents the on/off state of a permission. Applications can specify the significance of each permission ID.
